entities.name: Jaya Sinhavarman IV
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaya Simhavarman IV or originally Mahendravarman, or Chế Chí (制至), son of Chế Mân and first queen Princess Bhaskaradevi, was born in 1284 as Prince Harijitatmaja. He reigned as the king of Champa from 1307 - 1312.
